preparation.note: Native BUILD/nuclear optimization can move or flip existing side-chain atoms and alter hydrogen placement. Not a hydrogen-only fixed-heavy-coordinate variant or a pH-specific protonation prediction.

recall.name: Phenix RPF Recall
recall.scale_scope: Fixed full pooled 2,000-model preparation variant; same bounds for all six views and selected-set displays.
recall.native_value_source: Accepted decoded native overview fields at their original two-decimal precision.
recall.metric_note: Full-construct independent per-model RPF after Phenix Reduce BUILD/nuclear preparation. Original model identities and clustering/Bonsai coordinates are retained; these scores refer to the separately hash-pinned optimized preparation. No score enters clustering or ensemble selection. The existing Phenix-prepared results use a different RPF engine binary from the saved Reduce baseline. Four saved baseline bridge checks passed. Paired score differences are descriptive and are not attributed solely to hydrogen placement or preparation.
